newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA C.BANK TO CUT MAIN RATE TO 43.08 PCT/YR.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA C.BANK TO CUT MAIN RATE TO 43.08 PCT/YR.

text.p: The Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) will cut its main interest rate to 43.08 percent annually from 51.48 percent from Monday, commercial bank dealers said.
"The BNB informed us that it sets its main interest rate at 43.08 percent annually from Monday," a dealer told Reuters.
BNB officials were not immediately available for comment. An official statement could be expected later on Thursday.
The BNB has said new main interest rate would give 52.69 percent effective annual interest rate calculated through the monthly accruals, the dealer added.

The rate cut reflected the lower yields on short-term government securities auctioned this week. The BNB adjusts its main rate to the weighted average monthly yield on one- and four-week discount T-bills sold from Friday through Thursday.

Yields to maturity on one- and four-week T-bills auctioned daily from Friday through Thursday ranged between 0.41-0.51 percent and 3.55-3.83 percent respectively, down from 0.58-0.82 percent and 3.84-4.68 percent in the week May 9-15.
The BNB has also said that from next week it would adjust its main rate only to the weighted average monthly yield on four-week discount T-bills, the dealer said.
